title: Live updates: Trump hosts Xi for US-China summit in Washington - CNN
description: Chinese leader Xi Jinping is in Washington, DC, for the first time in over a decade to meet with President Donald Trump at a series of events. Follow live updates.

title: Bob Pettit, basketball great who was named the NBA’s first MVP, dies at 93 - The Washington Post
description: He led the St. Louis Hawks to the 1958 title and revolutionized his position, establishing himself as one of the greatest players of his generation.

title: New Jersey Gov. Sherrill calls on her lieutenant governor to resign - The Washington Post
description: An investigation found that Dale Caldwell sexually harassed a woman and violated state ethics rules. He has denied allegations of misconduct, and Sherrill said Caldwell had until Friday to step down.

title: Senate rejects measure to block Trump from ordering more strikes on Iran - The Washington Post
description: The administration ignored passage of a similar resolution in June, arguing that it lacks the force of law.
